definitions.rtt: IRTT RTT in ms, not absolute one-way delay
definitions.jitter: p99 absolute RTT IPDV, not RTP jitter
definitions.aggregation: median of per-window quantiles; paired deltas are medians of paired changes
definitions.repeats: n=3 independent paired windows for main comparisons; not packet count
definitions.charts: IPv4 selected explicitly for latency charts; both families in data and report

interpretation.repetitions: Three paired windows; packet count is not number of independent replicates.
interpretation.rtt: IRTT RTT excludes measured reflector processing; full client send-to-receive is also saved as application_round_trip. No absolute one-way delay or RTT/2 inference.
interpretation.ipdv: Absolute per-packet IPDV quantiles; not RTP interarrival jitter.
interpretation.late: IRTT out-of-order replies, separate from RTT deadline exceedance.
interpretation.pps: Bounded 250 pps diagnostic, not discovered maximum. Direct-only 1000/5000 pps controls expose IRTT timer misses, not VPN capacity.
interpretation.environment: Local clean LAN only; no emulated Internet/mobile delay/loss; not universal VoIP/game qualification.
interpretation.budgets: Exploratory engineering budgets: median paired p50 increase <=2 ms, p99 <=5 ms, loss <=0.1 percentage point; not an industry standard.
interpretation.resources: CPU observer spans probe startup, wait and background tail; 100% process CPU is one vCPU; counters are VM/interface interval deltas, not socket-specific causal proof. Read-only /proc skip counts are reported separately; they do not authorize signals or establish packet loss.
interpretation.restoration: Private IRTT installation intentionally retained as authorized; old binaries/results and network state restored.

definitions.speed: TCP P4 and UDP600 n=3; TCP P1 and offered UDP1000 n=1 diagnostic, not a discovered UDP ceiling
definitions.cpu: Observer group sum, 100% means one vCPU; includes startup/wait/tail
definitions.criteria: Proposed engineering checks: <=5% speed loss with CV<=5%, no >1 ms p99 increase; not a universal product qualification
definitions.release: Experimental uncommitted native overlay, not a certified/published release

followup.scope: Independent ACK-only and usage-only changes on frozen low-latency df933 baseline. This is not validation of the current release/dist binary or unrelated primary PMTU/mobile changes.

long_tail.definition: Fresh n3 60s VoIP RTT pairs on UDP-FakeTLS IPv4 only. Independent from the original short-window alert and the metadata-traced 60s n1 pair; no speeds or UDP600 in this follow-up.

subwindows.definition: Six consecutive 10s bins aligned to first client monotonic send, all packets and all six bins retained; paired n3 per bin. Same p99 +1ms/p50 +0.3ms thresholds; no selection of only favourable portions. Supplemental analysis, original short-window alert preserved.
